Added `rotate_token_with_retry` as a new function that:
- Calls the existing `rotate_token` (unchanged) up to `max_attempts` times
- Uses `should_retry_rotation` (unchanged) to decide whether to retry
- Applies exponential backoff between attempts
- Raises `TokenRotationError` after all attempts are exhausted
